# UCI224 Gas Sensor Array Drift Dataset

Alexander Vergara (2012), Gas Sensor Array Drift Dataset. UCI Machine Learning Repository. [Dataset record](https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/224/gas%2Bsensor%2Barray%2Bdrift%2Bdataset) · [DOI](https://doi.org/10.24432/C5RP6W) · [CC BY 4.0 license](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

The repository includes the unmodified [source archive](uci224_curl.zip). The [source evaluator](../../../scripts/evaluate_uci224_day2.py) reads the ten acquisition batches from this archive. SHA-256 recorded by the experiment protocol:
